mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (title, content, sendertype, senderid, receivertype, receiverid, isread, createtime) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{sendertype}, #{senderid}, #{receivertype}, #{receiverid}, 0, #{createtime})

INSERT INTO message (title, content, sendertype, senderid, receivertype, receiverid, isread, createtime) VALUES
(#{item.title}, #{item.content}, #{item.sendertype}, #{item.senderid}, #{item.receivertype}, #{item.receiverid}, 0, #{item.createtime})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, CASE m.receivertype WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT studentname FROM student WHERE studentid = m.receiverid) WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT teachername FROM teacher WHERE teacherid = m.receiverid) WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT classname FROM classinfo WHERE classid = m.receiverid) END as receivername FROM message m WHERE m.sendertype = #{sendertype} AND m.senderid = #{senderid} ORDER BY m.createtime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE sendertype = #{sendertype} AND senderid = #{senderid}

SELECT m.*, CASE m.sendertype WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT realname FROM admin WHERE adminid = m.senderid) WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT teachername FROM teacher WHERE teacherid = m.senderid) END as sendername, CASE m.receivertype WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT studentname FROM student WHERE studentid = m.receiverid) WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT teachername FROM teacher WHERE teacherid = m.receiverid) WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT classname FROM classinfo WHERE classid = m.receiverid) END as receivername FROM message m WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET isread = 1, readtime = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE message SET isread = 1, readtime = NOW() WHERE receivertype = #{receivertype} AND receiverid = #{receiverid} AND isread = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receivertype = #{receivertype} AND receiverid = #{receiverid} AND isread = 0
